simple.summary: הֲפֵכָה (hăphêkâh) means destruction First listed occurrence: Gen 19 29.

definitions.full: H2018. haphekah הֲפֵכָה noun feminine overthrow (compare especially Assyrian abiktu Dl W ), of the cities (of the plain) Gen 19:29 ; compare [ מַהְמֵּכָה ] and הָפַךְ 1b.
